title: Voicings Payload v1
description: Cross-repo contract for delivering the OPTIC-K voicing position cloud from ix to a Three.js consumer (GA Prime Radiant being the first). The payload is a *pointer* — it tells the consumer where to fetch the binary positions buffer + metadata sidecar, plus rendering hints (scene offset, default spread/point-size). The actual position data is served as a Float32Array binary file, never inlined here. Returned by ix MCP tool `ix_voicings_payload`. Plan: ix:docs/plans/2026-05-02-voicings-in-prime-radiant.md.
$comment: Producer: ix-agent (handler `voicings_payload`, tool `ix_voicings_payload`). Consumer: GA Prime Radiant `createVoicingCloud` (ReactComponents/ga-react-components/src/components/PrimeRadiant/VoicingCloud.ts). Backing data: ix-voicings serve_viz binary buffer derived from voicing-layout.json. Related: schemas/voicing-handle.schema.json (orthogonal — handles are for individual voicing references, this payload is for bulk-position transport).

schema.description: Schema-version literal. Bumping this string is a one-way door — every consumer must coordinate.

format.description: Sole supported format in v1. Future versions may add `binary-positions+colors+meta` etc.

positions_url.description: URL of the raw Float32Array buffer. Length = total * 3 floats * 4 bytes. Per-instrument blocks contiguous in the order given by `meta.instruments`. Server should expose CORS for browser consumers.

meta_url.description: URL of the JSON sidecar describing the binary layout (see $defs.position_meta).

scene_offset.description: [x, y, z] world-space translation for the cloud root. Default [200, 0, 0] keeps it clear of the GA governance graph at origin. Changing the default in the producer is a UX one-way door — users learn the cloud lives 'to the right'.

default_spread.description: Initial per-axis triangular-noise jitter the consumer should apply when building geometry. The OPTIC-K precompute packs ~99% of each instrument into sub-1-unit cluster knots; without spread the cloud collapses to ~15 sub-pixel blobs. Suggested default 1.5.

default_point_size.description: Initial Three.js PointsMaterial.size. Suggested default 0.3 with sizeAttenuation enabled.

position_meta.title: Position Buffer Metadata Sidecar
position_meta.description: Schema of the JSON file at meta_url. Tells the consumer how to slice the contiguous binary buffer into per-instrument blocks and where the cloud sits in coordinate space.

total.description: Total number of voicings in the buffer. Buffer length must equal total * 3 floats.

instruments.description: Ordered list of per-instrument blocks. Sum of counts must equal total.

name.description: v1 fixes the instrument enum at the same three GA recognises. Adding instruments is a v2 concern.

offset.description: Index of this block's first voicing (units = voicings, not bytes). Multiply by 12 to get the byte offset into the binary.

count.description: Number of voicings in this block.
